description: This file contains classes related to fault injection for Azure Table Transaction State Storage in Orleans, including a wrapper class for injecting faults during store operations and a factory class for creating instances with fault injection capabilities.

classes.name: FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorage
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing ITransactionalStateStorage that injects faults during store operations for testing purposes.

classes.name: FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorageFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing ITransactionalStateStorageFactory and ILifecycleParticipant to create instances of FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorage with fault injection capabilities.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the transactional state from the underlying storage.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores the transactional state, with fault injection hooks before and after the store operation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorage for a given state type.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle, delegating to the underlying factory.

methods.name: Create (static method)
methods.description: Creates an instance of FaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionStateStorageFactory using dependency injection.
